title: Application of Massachusetts Electric Company under the provisons of G. L. c. 164, § 94G 1/2 and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. No. 528, for approvial by the Department of Public Utilities of a change in the Company's Oil Conservation Adjustment charge to be biled to the Company's customers pursuant to meter reading taken in the billing months of October, November and December 1992. The Oil Conservation Adjustment surcharge recoversthe cost of conversion from oil-fired to coal -fired generation and its calculation is based on the respective coasts of burning coal and oil.
